_: Boxes in design pt, x0 y0 x1 y1, on the capture named first. gen.py's cut() multiplies by SCALE (3.0 capture px per pt) and writes assets/art/<id>.png. p1/p5/p7 are read through gen.py's INPAINT: the chrome the boards draw again in CSS is patched out of the capture with a Coons fill before the crop is taken.
_rule: Only a photograph is cropped. Every rule, fill, glyph and run of type on these screens is rebuilt, so nothing here carries interface pixels except where an opaque drawn element covers them: 06-banner and 07-banner both include the top of the avatar, and the drawn white avatar ring sits on exactly that ground.
